description_en: Queries the tag values of a tag key
description_zh: 查询指定标签键对应的标签值
kebab_example: aliyun tag list-tag-values --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --key k1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagValues

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

For more information about region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330902.html
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

关于地域ID的详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330902.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The tag key. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query
parameters.help_zh: 标签键，用于查询的过滤条件
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The token that is used to start the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of tag values to return on each page.

Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的标签值个数。

最大值：1000。默认值：50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.

Format: `ALIYUN::${ProductCode}::${ResourceType}`. All letters in the value of this parameter must be in uppercase.

`ProductCode`: the service code. You can set this field to a value obtained from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html operation.
`ResourceType`: the resource type. You can set this field to a value obtained from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，用于查询的过滤条件。

格式：`ALIYUN::${ProductCode}::${ResourceType}`，全部大写。

`ProductCode`：云服务code。从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html返回参数中获取。
`ResourceType`：资源类型。从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2330915.html返回参数中获取
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The category of the tags. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

ResourceTag: resource tags, including custom and system tags. This is the default value.
MetaTag: preset tags.

The value of this parameter is not case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
标签类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

ResourceTag（默认值）：资源标签。包括自定义标签和系统标签。
MetaTag：预置标签。

取值不区分大小写
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the query. Valid values:

EQUAL (default): exact match
PREFIX: prefix-based fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh:
模糊查询类型。取值：

EQUAL（默认值）：精确查询。
PREFIX：根据前缀进行模糊查询
parameters.name: fuzzy_type

parameters.help_en:
The tag value for a fuzzy query.

This parameter is used together with the `FuzzyType` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
模糊查询的标签值。

该参数与`FuzzyType`配合使用
parameters.name: tag_filter_value

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether the next query is required. The value of this parameter may be empty.

If the value of this parameter is empty (`"NextToken": ""`), all results are returned, and the next query is not required.
If the value of this parameter is not empty, the next query is required, and the value is the token used to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
根据`NextToken`判断是否具备下一个查询开始的Token。取值：

如果`NextToken`为空，即`"NextToken": ""`，表示没有下一个。
如果`NextToken`有值，则该值就是下一个查询开始的Token
